- Introductions & success criteria (5–10m)
- Procurement checklist & contract timeline (10–15m)
- Security/compliance Q&A (SOC 2, data retention, access controls) (20m)
- Technical integration & runbook (SE-led, 20–25m)
- Mutual action plan and next steps (5–10m)

Available slots (PT):
- Tue 20 Apr — 09:00–10:15 or 14:00–15:15

If those don't work, share two windows that suit procurement + security + your engineering lead and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I attached a short kickoff agenda and our onboarding steps doc.
